value.rationale: The problem asks for a sharp criterion governing arbitrary nonconstant iid coefficient laws in a central Dirichlet mixed-norm randomization theorem. The result resolves the complete outstanding sub-four exponent interval for every positive Hardy exponent, identifies a genuine L2-versus-Lq change at q=2, and exhibits a structural infinite-variance obstruction. The no-moment reverse lemma also replaces a previously assumed fourth moment. It is a complete natural classification, not an arbitrary fixed-number computation or a textbook substitution.
